facts.fact: An October 2024 ANPH concept note describes the Mobile ID project, with ANSIE engineers as technical mentors, as a smartphone identification system using biometrics and PKI and designed to interoperate with the national interoperability platform (PNI), presented as being launched.

An October 2024 concept note by the national disability agency (ANPH) presents the Mobile ID launch and a hackathon to build Mobile ID applications that improve access to public services for persons with disabilities.

DJI.note: Mobile ID is an authentication project; the note says nothing of the national ID register.
Hackathon prizes only; no startup law, strategy or fund.
Hackathon only; no hub or incubator named.
